audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Weighted and Euclidean radii are interchanged in the connection estimate; The collar construction does not preserve the full stated H^1 data class; The stated SBV compactness hypothesis controls jump amplitude rather than jump measure
limitations: P1 — Weighted and Euclidean radii are interchanged in the connection estimate — Counterevidence and scope: The informal delta_0 << c_F convention on source p.18 is not met by the unit-gap example and cannot be achieved merely by shrinking delta_0 in that family. A separate large-gap example demonstrates the exit-radius defect even with strong smallness. No counterexample to the entire evolution theorem or its conclusion is claimed.

P2 — The collar construction does not preserve the full stated H^1 data class — Counterevidence and scope: This disproves the displayed construction for general H^1 data, not existence of every possible recovery sequence. A different global H^1 construction in the checked Laux-Liu source does not itself justify this collar construction.

P3 — The stated SBV compactness hypothesis controls jump amplitude rather than jump measure — Counterevidence and scope: The actual application also has a uniform jump-area bound from the level/perimeter estimates; the checked primary SBV compactness result applies with that stronger bound.

P4 — Projected and classical spatial gradients are used incompatibly, with a plus-well sign error — Counterevidence and scope: The source later explicitly asks for the classical spatial gradient on p.12; with that convention the relevant norm identities are restored. The sign does not change the projection line. No counterexample to a prepared limiting solution or the integrated energy estimate is asserted.

P5 — The preparation assumptions allow remote small droplets and do not force the stated Hausdorff conclusion — Counterevidence and scope: The droplet may disappear immediately on the relevant shrinking time scale. No counterexample at a fixed positive time is established. The Hausdorff claim is not needed by the retained perimeter/BV/slicing route to the main conclusions.

P6 — A varying higher-codimension normal frame contributes an omitted connection term — Counterevidence and scope: The coordinate-free nearest-point projection satisfies DP(m) nu_rad=0 and norm DP <= 1+C delta, giving the required estimate without the incorrect frame identity.

P7 — The curvature extension is not constant along normals in its cutoff annulus — Counterevidence and scope: Where eta_0=1 the derivative is zero. The support of xi lies in the smaller constant-cutoff region, so the actually used identity (xi dot grad)H=0 remains valid.

P8 — The derivative of the negative part has the wrong sign — Counterevidence and scope: The subsequent estimate takes absolute values and applies Young's inequality, so the sign correction does not change the bound.
P9 — The limiting bulk-gradient energy coefficient is missing a factor one half — Counterevidence and scope: Restoring the coefficient preserves the claimed O(epsilon) preparation bound.

P10 — The zero-normal convention loses a term in the final square completion — Counterevidence and scope: The construction establishes an algebraic and initial-time discrepancy, not an almost-everywhere interior-time counterexample to Lemma A.2. The omitted negative remainder is bounded by C E_epsilon. A usual generic factor, such as 3, also repairs the subsequent three-square inequality.
Limitations: The acquired target is arXiv v3; no equivalence to the 2025 journal version of record is asserted.
Limitations: The Lin-Pan-Wang reference has selected complete units read, not all 56 pages.
Limitations: The harmonic-flow dependency is checked locally at the declared level; a full independent redevelopment of partial regularity is not claimed.
Limitations: P1 and P2 establish defects of the stated proof steps under the qualified hypotheses, not counterexamples to every possible main-theorem conclusion or replacement construction.
Limitations: P5 and the prepared-plateau part of P10 have the explicit initial-time limits stated in the report.
Limitations: A bounded retained public lookup found no separate applicable supplement or code; this is not proof that none exists, and missing code is not a mathematical defect.
Limitations: A failed Laux-Liu publisher acquisition is retained as a non-PDF payload; the separate exact arXiv v2 fallback is the checked source.
Limitations: No author code was executed. Original review coverage remains historically attributed; the current focused independent acceptance is recorded in provenance. Human reviews remain empty.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
